purpose: Derive candidate model dimensions from H2-approved canonical indicator families without a preset dimension count.
coding_sequence: AI and H1 independently code each canonical indicator family.
H2 reviews every disagreement, merge, split, cross-label, and unclassified family.
Only after H2 adjudication are candidate dimensions constructed.
Formal dimensions are retained only after indicator hard-gate selection.
merge_split_rules: Merge indicators that measure the same theoretical object and have the same explanatory role.
A data source, parameter, threshold, transform, or time-window difference alone does not create a new dimension.
Split substantive paper content, publication opportunity, and background control roles.
Split when construct definition or the T0 boundary is substantively different.
Allow temporary multi-label coding only when the evidence genuinely spans constructs; H2 must resolve the formal mapping.
Embedding or clustering output may flag possible errors but cannot create, merge, or approve a dimension.
retention_boundary: No target M, D, or F is allowed.
A formal predictive dimension needs at least one indicator passing every hard gate.
A formal dimension needs support from at least two independent research groups.
Opportunity and context-control dimensions remain separate from substantive innovation dimensions.
A candidate dimension with no surviving indicator is deleted with its reason retained.
